text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,819.25, up 1.85% on the day and 1.7% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.17% (5‑day +0.85%). Advances outpaced declines (269 vs 226) and the breadth score stayed in the “HEALTHY” zone at 64.3, indicating a fairly broad rally across the market. The India VIX, a volatility gauge, slipped marginally to 17.7, suggesting lower fear.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹4,479 crn today and a cumulative ₹33,739 crn over five days, extending a 19‑day buying streak. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) turned slightly positive with a ₹4,019 crn inflow today after a week of outflows. Leading sectors were banks (PSU and private), financial services, FMCG and auto, while IT, oil‑gas and media lagged. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 0.91 for Nifty and 0.87 for Bank Nifty, indicating modest call‑side bias; the “max‑pain” levels sit around 25,700 (Nifty) and 63,500 (Bank Nifty) with call walls at 26,000 and 66,000 respectively.

Watch the Nifty 50 pivot at 25,796 (pivot) and support at 25,642; a break below could test the 25,500 put wall. For Bank Nifty, the pivot is 63,695 with support at 63,256 and resistance at 64,174. Key headlines to monitor include RBI’s upcoming overnight variable‑rate repo auction and any further foreign fund inflows, which could sustain the current upside. Keep an eye on crude oil prices and global equity cues, as they have been supporting the rally.
